name: Moc Chau food guide
summary: The morning cup is cold yogurt or fresh milk in the farm town. At Ban Ang the meal is bamboo sticky rice, grilled stream fish, and jar wine from a gourd.
body: Eat the plateau, not Mai Chau’s rice valley. Ban Ang puts bamboo sticky rice, grilled stream fish, smoked meat, flash-fried calf, love sticky rice, leaf-yeast wine, bamboo-tube fish, and forest greens on one table.

Hmong cooking brings pounded rice cake and thắng cố. Thai and Muong cooking brings hearth-smoked buffalo, five-colour sticky rice, forest greens, and canh bon. Dao cooking brings soured meat with rượu hoẵng. The night market adds dried buffalo and hearth sausage.
specialtiesLead: The plates with a photograph come first. The other plateau specialties follow.

sections.heading: The plateau table
paragraphs: Cooked plates. Pa pỉnh tộp, cá suối, and cá suối nướng are one fish. Thịt hun khói, thịt trâu gác bếp, thịt trâu khô, and bò hun khói stay apart. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Smoked meat
spots.address: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43
spots.note: Smoked meat from the Ban Ang table, kept apart from hearth-smoked buffalo, dried buffalo, and smoked beef.

spots.name: Chao calf
spots.address: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43
spots.note: Flash-fried dairy calf, about a week old, cut small and sent twice through hot fat with ginger, lemongrass, garlic, and chili. The meat is soft, rich, and sweet, and not greasy.

spots.name: Bamboo-tube fish
spots.address: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43
spots.note: Fish cooked in a bamboo tube and eaten from the tube at a Ban Ang meal.

spots.name: Love sticky rice
spots.address: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43
spots.note: Sticky rice at the Ban Ang table, the plate called xôi tình yêu, kept apart from the five-colour rice.

spots.name: Forest greens
spots.address: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43
spots.note: Forest-vegetable dishes cooked with the Ban Ang meal, separate from the forest-green salad.

spots.name: Forest-green salad
spots.note: A salad of forest greens at bản Vặt, served with bamboo rice and grilled fish.

spots.name: Dried buffalo
spots.address: Farm-town night market, around the Pha Luong light park
spots.note: Dried buffalo from the night market, eaten with hearth sausage and a cup of strong wine.

spots.name: Smoked beef
spots.note: Smoked beef to carry home, kept apart from the buffalo plates.

spots.name: Buffalo lap

spots.name: Pounded rice cake

spots.name: Thang co

spots.name: Bon soup
spots.note: Canh bon, a soup on the Thai and Muong side of the plateau table.

spots.name: Nam pia
spots.note: Nậm pịa, a plateau dish kept under its own name.

spots.name: Flowering mustard
spots.note: Cải ngồng, flowering mustard, kept apart from cải mèo.

spots.name: Trout
spots.note: Trout, one of the plateau specialties.

spots.name: Man pig

spots.name: Lon lung pork
spots.note: Thịt lợn lửng, a Hmong pork on the plateau table.

spots.name: Dried pork
spots.note: Dried pork from what the plateau raises.

spots.name: Rock snail
spots.note: Ốc đá, rock snail, on the plateau list of dishes to try.

spots.name: Ga mo
spots.note: Gà mọ, a Thai chicken kept apart from the grilled chicken at bản Vặt.

spots.name: Ban flower
spots.note: Hoa ban, the ban flower, served among the Thai dishes.

sections.heading: Wine
paragraphs: Five named wines. The night-market wines are sold without a still, so they are not a sixth drink. A strength is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Leaf-yeast wine
spots.address: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43
spots.note: Leaf-yeast rice wine at Ban Ang, kept apart from the jar wine.

spots.name: Corn wine
spots.note: Corn wine, poured with the welcome and listed with the Hmong dishes.

spots.name: Hoang wine
spots.note: Rượu hoẵng, the wine served beside Dao soured meat.

spots.name: Tao meo wine
spots.note: Wine made from táo mèo, carried home apart from the fruit itself.

sections.heading: Dairy and tea
paragraphs: The morning cup is in the farm town. Yogurt is three cups: plain, black sticky-rice, and passion-fruit. Fresh milk, milk cake, and the hill tea sit with them. Two visit write-ups print a dairy gate of 20,000 VND and 10,000 VND, both at 08:00–18:00.

spots.name: Black sticky-rice yogurt
spots.address: Tiểu khu 34, xã Tân Lập, on the 3 May 2024 announcement
spots.note: Black sticky-rice yogurt, the nếp cẩm cup beside the plain yogurt.

spots.name: Passion-fruit yogurt
spots.address: Tiểu khu 34, xã Tân Lập, on the 3 May 2024 announcement
spots.note: Passion-fruit yogurt, the chanh leo cup beside the plain yogurt.

spots.name: Milk cake
spots.note: Milk cake, eaten with the fresh milk and the yogurt.

sections.heading: Fruit
paragraphs: Hau plum is the fruit with a valley. You pick it at Na Ka from March to May. Dried plum is a different bite. Strawberries, navel oranges, persimmons, apricots, and peaches are fruit you pick and sample.

spots.name: Dried hau plum
spots.address: Chiềng Sơn, on the 3 May 2024 announcement
spots.note: Dried hau plum, a packed fruit, not the fresh plum at Na Ka.

sections.heading: Packed foods
paragraphs: Bánh khảo, kẹo dồi, and táo mèo are packed to carry home.

spots.name: Tao meo
spots.note: Táo mèo, the fruit you carry home, kept apart from the wine made from it.

spots.name: Banh khao
spots.note: Bánh khảo, a cake to carry home from the plateau.

spots.name: Keo doi
spots.note: Kẹo dồi, a candy to carry home from the plateau.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: The night market is the walk after dark. Dried buffalo and hearth sausage are already on the list. This row is the ground. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Moc Chau night market
spots.address: Farm-town walking street, around the Pha Luong light park
spots.note: A ground of more than 2 ha around the Pha Luong light park, with nearly 60 stalls split into a trade side and a food side. Weekends are the fuller nights, and the food side serves dried buffalo and hearth sausage with a cup of strong wine.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: The morning cup is plain yogurt, black sticky-rice yogurt, passion-fruit yogurt, or fresh milk in the farm town. Bamboo sticky rice is the other early plate when a Ban Ang meal includes it. The hour is Check on arrival.
